review_scope: development-only independent-host expansion; no train/validation/test assignment and no model use
method: Verified project title, publisher identity, revision and contributor evidence against all 10 pinned Manifold project records.
Required an unambiguous CC BY 4.0 statement in every separately pinned project record and rejected contradictory license metadata.
Reviewed rendered openings, endings, structure and recorded exclusions for all 10 selected sections.
Reviewed all 45 document comparisons and all threshold matches among 469 screened cross-document paragraphs.

source_limitations: Five documents are attributed to the University System of Georgia.
Institutional educational prose and English-language content remain overrepresented.
All content uses Manifold APIs, so delivery-format diversity did not increase in this wave.
The lexical duplicate screen cannot establish absence of paraphrased or semantic overlap.

decision: Accept as a development-only fourth expansion wave. Preserve 10 work/contributor groups, exclude every inspected work from the future untouched test, and perform a cross-wave balance and identity audit before acquiring against the remaining gaps.
